info.name: School API — School Accounts
info.description:
Director first-login on the **app host**. **Documented:** `GET|POST|DELETE /school-accounts/session`, `POST /school-accounts/password`, `GET|POST /school-accounts/username`.

Campus routes live in `Campus-Session.postman_collection.json` — do not add them here.

- Host: `{{appHost}}` or 403 `School accounts are only allowed on the app host`.
- Auth: `{{schoolAccessToken}}` (HMAC `:school-account-session`). Sign-in writes `schoolAccessToken` and `schoolAccountId`.
- Username lookup/claim stay on app host until the slug is claimed; then the app session dies (401).

Shared environment: `environments/School-API.local.postman_environment.json`.

- `{{baseUrl}}` is the **backend** (`http://127.0.0.1:5000`), not Next on `3000`.
- Prefer `x-school-host` over `Host`. Matching lowercases and strips `:{port}`.
- Tokens are HMAC (`payload.signature`), not JWT. Admin `{{accessToken}}` will not verify on school/campus routes (different HMAC material). School and campus share `:school-account-session`.
- Error JSON (except health): `{ "error": "<string>" }`. No 422. Wrapper-only 500 is `{ "error": "Internal server error" }`.
- Do not invent routes or status codes. Later batches land in the matching collection file — do not grow a monolith.

item.name: School Accounts
item.description:
Director first-login on `app.<rootHost>` only (`{{appHost}}`). Identity is the pending tenant (`tenants` / `tenant_<slug>` after claim), not `platform.admins`.

**Host:** `rejectIfNotAppHost` / `isAppHost` — `x-school-host` or `Host` must be `app.{{rootHost}}` (e.g. `app.e-school.et` or `app.e-school.et:3000`). Admin, campus, apex, or empty Host → `403 { "error": "School accounts are only allowed on the app host" }`.

Unlike `/admin/session`, **GET and DELETE also enforce the app host.** School DELETE returns 403 on the wrong host (and when the account is suspended). Admin DELETE always returns 200.

After the director claims a username, app-host session read returns **401** (not 403). Sign-in of a claimed account returns **403** `{ "error": "Use your campus host" }` — switch to the **Campus Session** collection (`Campus-Session.postman_collection.json`) with `{{schoolHost}}` and `{{campusAccessToken}}`.

**Username (Batch 3):** `GET|POST /school-accounts/username` stay on `{{appHost}}` + `{{schoolAccessToken}}`. Calling them with `{{schoolHost}}` is **403** `School accounts are only allowed on the app host` (not the campus-host error). After a slug is claimed, GET/POST username on the old app token → **401** Unauthorized.

header.description: HMAC school session from POST /school-accounts/session (`payload.signature`, secret suffix `:school-account-session`). Missing, non-Bearer, expired, admin token, or claimed-slug account → 401.
**Required.** Must be `app.<rootHost>` after port strip. Unlike GET /admin/session, wrong host is 403.

request.description:
Returns the current director first-login session if the Bearer token is a valid school HMAC **and** the request is on the app host.

**Auth:** required. `Authorization: Bearer {{schoolAccessToken}}`. `readBearerToken` only accepts a header that starts with `Bearer `.

**Who:** a director in first-login (tenant has **no slug yet**). Platform admins cannot use `{{accessToken}}` here (different HMAC material). After username claim, this token is rejected (401) — use campus session on the school host.

**Host (required):** `isAppHost`. `{{appHost}}` = `app.e-school.et:3000`. Admin / campus / apex → `403 { "error": "School accounts are only allowed on the app host" }`.

**Side effects:** none. Does not rotate or extend the token.

**Success `200`:** `{ accountId, email, expiresAt, mustChangePassword, nextStep }` — **no `token` field**. `nextStep` is `"password"` while `mustChangePassword` is true, otherwise `"username"`.

**Errors that exist:** `401 { "error": "Unauthorized" }` (missing/empty/invalid/expired token, admin HMAC, unknown account, **or slug already claimed**); `403` wrong host or `"This school account is suspended"`; `405` for PUT/PATCH/etc.

**Not used:** 400, 404 (path exists), 409, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.

request.description:
Issues an HMAC school-account session when credentials match a tenant that has **not** claimed a slug **and** the request is on the app host.

**Auth:** none on the request. Email is trimmed and lowercased (`normalizeTenantEmail`). Non-string or missing `email` / `password` become `""` — there is **no field-level 400**. Bad, empty, or unknown credentials → `401 { "error": "Invalid email or password" }` (same message; no email-format errors on this route).

**Who:** a director invited by platform admin, signing in on `app.<rootHost>` (`/first-login`). School accounts cannot sign in on `/admin/session`. After a slug is claimed, this route returns 403 — use campus sign-in.

**Host (required):** `isAppHost` — `x-school-host` or `Host` must be `app.{{rootHost}}`. Otherwise `403 { "error": "School accounts are only allowed on the app host" }`.

**Side effects:** issues a new HMAC token (`SESSION_TTL_SECONDS`, default 28800) signed with secret suffix `:school-account-session` (admin tokens will not verify). Best-effort `recordDirectorSignIn` (first successful app sign-in only; failure does not fail the request). Does **not** set cookies (the Next app stores the token after this call). Does not set `platform_admin_session`.

**Success `200`:** `{ accountId, email, token, expiresAt, mustChangePassword, nextStep }`. First-login tenants have `mustChangePassword: true` and `nextStep: "password"`. After POST /school-accounts/password, sign-in returns `mustChangePassword: false` and `nextStep: "username"`. Copy `token` into `{{schoolAccessToken}}` (the test script does this).

**Errors that exist:** 400 invalid JSON; 401 bad/empty/unknown credentials; 403 wrong host, suspended (`This school account is suspended`), or claimed slug (`Use your campus host`); 405 other methods.

**Not used:** 404, 409, 422, and no distinct 500 from this handler.

header.description: The Next first-login app sends this. The handler reads the token only to detect **403** (wrong host or suspended). Missing or invalid tokens still return 200 when the host is the app host.
**Validated.** Wrong host → 403. This is unlike DELETE /admin/session, which never checks host.

request.description:
Client-side sign-out acknowledgement for the director first-login session.

**Auth:** the handler **does** call `readSchoolAccountSession`, but only **403** results are forwarded. `401` (missing, invalid, expired, admin token, or claimed slug) is treated as success.

**Who:** the Next first-login app calls this to drop its stored token. Anyone who can reach the backend on the **app host** can get 200; it is a no-op on the server when not 403.

**Host (required):** `isAppHost`. Wrong host → `403 { "error": "School accounts are only allowed on the app host" }`. **Do not copy admin DELETE** (admin always 200).

**Suspended:** if the token is valid enough to load the tenant and status is `suspended`, DELETE returns `403 { "error": "This school account is suspended" }` (same gate as GET).

**Side effects:** **none on the server.** HMAC tokens stay valid until `expiresAt`. The client must discard `{{schoolAccessToken}}`. There is no deny-list.

**Success:** `200 { "ok": true }` for DELETE when the read is ok **or** the error is 401.

**Errors that exist:** `403` wrong host or suspended; `405` for methods other than GET/POST/DELETE.

**Not used:** 400, 401 (swallowed), 404, 409, 422.

request.description:
Replaces the director temporary password and clears `mustChangePassword`.

**Auth:** required. Handler calls `readSchoolAccountSession` first (same 401/403 rules as GET session), then `changeSchoolAccountPassword`.

**Who:** a signed-in director on the app host whose tenant has **no slug**. After username claim, GET session (and therefore this route) returns 401.

**Host (required):** app host on both the session read and the use case.

**Side effects:** hashes `newPassword` and `updatePassword` with `mustChangePassword: false`. Does **not** issue a new token — the existing `{{schoolAccessToken}}` stays valid. Next GET session / this response has `nextStep: "username"`.

**Body:** `{ currentPassword, newPassword }`. Non-strings become `""`. Validation (`validateNewSchoolPassword`) runs **before** current-password verify:
- `newPassword` shorter than **12** → `400 { "error": "Password must be at least 12 characters" }`
- `newPassword === currentPassword` → `400 { "error": "New password must be different from the current password" }`
Wrong current password (after validation) → `401 { "error": "Invalid email or password" }`.

**Success `200`:** `{ accountId, email, expiresAt, mustChangePassword: false, nextStep: "username" }` — **no `token` field**.

**Errors that exist:** 400 invalid JSON or password rules; 401 Unauthorized (session) or Invalid email or password (current password); 403 wrong host or suspended; 405 for non-POST.

The use case can also return `403 { "error": "Use your campus host" }` if a slug appears after the session read (race). The typical HTTP path for an already-claimed account is **401** from the session gate.

**Not used:** 404, 409, 422, and no distinct 500 from this handler.

item.name: Username
item.description: App-host first-login only (`{{appHost}}` + `{{schoolAccessToken}}`). Lookup is GET `?slug=`; claim is POST `{ slug }`. After claim, the app session dies (401) and the director signs in on `{{schoolHost}}`.

header.description: HMAC school session from POST /school-accounts/session (`payload.signature`, secret suffix `:school-account-session`). Missing, non-Bearer, expired, admin token, or claimed-slug account → 401.
**Required.** Must be `app.<rootHost>` after port strip. Campus `{{schoolHost}}` is 403 with the **app-host** error — do not look up usernames on the campus host.

query.description: Candidate username. Trimmed and lowercased. Missing param becomes "".

request.description:
Checks whether a school username (subdomain slug) is free. Same availability rules as `GET /admin/tenants/username`, but gated by a **school first-login session** on the **app host**.

**Auth:** required. `Authorization: Bearer {{schoolAccessToken}}`. The handler calls `readSchoolAccountSession` first — same 401/403 gate as `GET /school-accounts/session`.

**Who:** a director in first-login (tenant has **no slug yet**). Platform admin `{{accessToken}}` will not verify (different HMAC material). After the slug is claimed, this token is rejected (**401**, not 403).

**Host (required):** `isAppHost`. `{{appHost}}` = `app.e-school.et:3000`. Admin / campus / apex → `403 { "error": "School accounts are only allowed on the app host" }`. Do **not** send `{{schoolHost}}`.

**Query:** `slug` — trimmed and lowercased (`normalizeSchoolSlug`). Missing or non-string becomes `""`. Invalid, reserved, and taken names still return **200** with `available: false` (no 400 on this GET).

**Side effects:** none. Does not claim the slug.

**Success `200` available:** `{ username, available: true }` (no `reason`).
**Success `200` unavailable:** `{ username, available: false, reason }` where `reason` is `"invalid"` | `"reserved"` | `"taken"`.

**Errors that exist:** `401 { "error": "Unauthorized" }` (missing/empty/invalid/expired token, admin HMAC, unknown account, **or slug already claimed**); `403` wrong host or `"This school account is suspended"`; `405` for PUT/PATCH/DELETE/etc.

**Not used:** 400, 404 (path exists), 409, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler. Lookup-use-case 403s (`Unauthorized` / `Use your campus host`) are shadowed by the session gate (401 / 403) and are not returned as a separate HTTP shape.

request.description:
Claims a unique school username (subdomain slug), activates the tenant, and names `tenant_<slug>` (hyphens become underscores).

**Auth:** required. `Authorization: Bearer {{schoolAccessToken}}`. Session is read **before** the body is applied — claimed-slug tokens die here with **401** (HTTP test: second claim is 401, not 409).

**Who:** a director who has **already changed the temporary password** (`mustChangePassword: false`, `nextStep: "username"`). Claiming before password change → `409 { "error": "Change your password first" }`.

**Host (required):** `{{appHost}}` only. Admin / campus / apex → `403 { "error": "School accounts are only allowed on the app host" }`.

**Body:** `{ slug }`. Trimmed and lowercased. Missing/non-string becomes empty string (no field-level 400 except the slug validators below).

**Side effects:** `store.claimSlug` — sets `slug`, status `active`, and the tenant schema name. After success, app-host session/password/username routes reject this token (401). Sign in next on `{{schoolHost}}` via `POST /school-accounts/campus-session`.

**Success `200`:** `{ host, slug }` — `host` is `{slug}.{rootHost}` **without port** (e.g. `north-ridge.e-school.et`). **No token.**

**Slug 400s (after a valid session):** empty → `A subdomain slug is required`; invalid pattern → `Invalid slug: use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or number`; reserved (`www`, `api`, `app`, `admin`, `mail`, `ftp`) → `"<slug>" is reserved by the platform`.

**Errors that exist:** 400 invalid JSON or slug validation; 401 session gate (including already-claimed token); 403 wrong host or suspended; 409 password-not-changed, `"<slug>" is already taken`, or `This school already has a username` (use-case / concurrent claim — sequential second claim via HTTP is 401 because the session dies first); 405 other methods.

**Not used:** 404, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.
